testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the part root context menu: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:229:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the part root context menu ✔ Given an active saved part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block ✔ And the document root row is visible in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the document root row ✔ Then the root row is highlighted and the visible block edges are blue ✔ And the context menu offers file-location and file-path actions ✔ And the context menu offers drawing actions ✔ And the context menu offers Expand All Children, Collapse All Children and Find in Window ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the context menu closes and the block edges remain highlighted ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the blue edge highlighting disappears and the block remains visible
